request.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:GUARD

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red smock becomes ragged near-black charcoal with a thin bright violet trim; his skin becomes pallid light warm ash grey with no blue at all; his eyes glow bright violet; every small blue flame becomes bright violet; he wears a necklace of small pale warm ivory bones. Keep the face, hair, bandaged hands, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
